nodes.title: Prepare a delivery note
nodes.objective: Read the current specification and create a small workspace artifact.
nodes.prompt: Read the referenced specification on demand. Write delivery.txt in the workspace, then submit facts.prepared=true, a nonempty evidence object describing the preparation, and the artifact path.

nodes.title: Ask for user confirmation
nodes.objective: Let the user approve the prepared artifact before verification.
nodes.prompt: Show delivery.txt to the user and ask for approval. Submit decision.approved only after receiving the user's answer.

nodes.title: Verify the delivery
nodes.objective: Check the approved artifact and record the verification evidence.
nodes.prompt: Read the verification specification. Run check_artifact with artifactPath=delivery.txt, inspect its result, and submit facts.verified=true with evidence.note describing the check.
